integrity: All results are analytical with a reproducible exact-symbolic companion; no independent certification or exhaustive prior-literature coverage is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted hypercubes and completed two-stage fourth-order Gauss steps only. The exact positivity window is proved only for dimensions up to three; only eventual nearest-neighbor negativity is asserted for larger dimensions. No independent audit has been performed.
title: A three-cube barrier and an all-dimensional late-step positivity law for fourth-order Gauss diffusion
